None of its signatures use request, response, HTTP context or status-code types. It only throws the project's own domain errors (PayrollRuleError, UnknownRecordError). The constructor takes EmployeeRepository and TimesheetRepository, which come from the persistence layer. The layer model lets business depend on persistence, so these are dependency wiring, and calling them is not misplaced I/O. The file does not create or reach for any database, ORM, HTTP or file client itself. Its remaining logic is business rules: checking the hours range, checking the employee is active, approving timesheets and computing payslips. All of these belong in the domain layer.
